） Important
Although the examples in this section encourage you to paste in secret values for testing
purposes, you should never hardcode secrets into an application running in production. A
PowerShell
third party could use your secret to access resources. You can help keep your app's secrets
secure by using Azure Key Vault. For a practical example of how you can protect your app,
see Manage secrets in your server apps with Azure Key Vault.
 Tip
In the following examples, use a user's tenant ID to test that the script is working.
